environment.note: Application frame intervals, not display scan-out. No parallel compilation or agent-launched GPU benchmark.

protocol.sameBrowser: One browser and server; switch artifact-directory symlink between page loads. Alternate build order and workload order. Group individual runs by variant; ignore the harness summary that pools builds. Temporary harness changes are retained in same-browser-harness.patch.
protocol.separateBrowser: Earlier alternating comparisons launch a fresh browser for each two-scene invocation. Retained even when results are unfavorable.
protocol.artifactNames: final is the earlier rejected eight-frame paired candidate, not the delivered build.
